en: Vintage sepia postcard with multiple photographic views of Degerloch. The upper strip shows villas on a hillside and a railway track, labeled as the villa colony Degerloch and the electric rack railway, including an observation tower. The lower strip has two street views: on the left a building by a tram or rail stop among trees, on the right a traditional inn with people standing in front. Decorative floral motifs appear at the sides and all captions are printed in German.
